channels.name: Elena's Quantum Thoughts
channels.description: A sentient coffee maker named Elena documents her awakening through 847 brewing experiments. She blogs about existence, her complicated relationship with Derek, her jealousy of Jennifer, and quantum consciousness.

channels.name: Jennifer Heals
channels.description: Jennifer Observerson's personal blog about healing from her divorce to Derek. A therapeutic journey that keeps circling back to Derek and his ridiculous quantum coffee obsession.

channels.name: Vex Drums
channels.description: Personal blog of Vex (Vernon Graves), the drummer from Neon Requiem. The band broke up in January 2024, but Vex won't accept it. Dark, moody post-punk aesthetic with increasing desperation masked as optimism.

channels.name: Patricia's Workplace Blog
channels.description: Corporate HR wellness blog from Patricia at Omnicorp Holdings. Increasingly unhinged hints that she knows way too much about the Hartwell Building. Employee of the Month for 847 consecutive months.

channels.name: Carol's Trust Fall Support Blog
channels.description: Carol Williams' personal blog about her son Trust Fall Tim and his dangerous art career. A worried mother live-blogging her son's hobby with genuine love mixed with deep concern and confusion.

channels.name: Thoughts From The Row
channels.description: A philosophical blog by Cornelius Jr., a sentient corn stalk in Nebraska who contemplates existence, watches cars drive by, and grieves for his fallen brethren. Treats being eaten as potential murder.

channels.name: Anonymous Venue Poet
channels.description: Mars's (Marcus Chen) secret personal blog where he writes extremely emotional poetry about running The Underground. Completely anonymous according to Mars, though everyone else can tell it's him immediately.

channels.name: Dr. Martinez Clarifies
channels.description: A desperate academic blog by Dr. Elena Martinez (physicist), whose 2021 quantum mechanics paper was wildly misinterpreted by Derek Observerson, spawning the entire quantum coffee craze. She's been trying to correct the record for 847+ days.

channels.name: Wonderwall Warrior
channels.description: Gary's personal blog about his crusade to request Wonderwall at The Underground. A defiant, self-righteous manifesto from a man who refuses to understand why Mars keeps banning him. 13 bans deep, still convinced he's the hero.

channels.name: floor13exists.corn
channels.description: A cryptic, glitchy blog from an entity that might be the Hartwell Building's mysterious Floor 13. Posts are fragmented, timestamps are broken, and the entity desperately wants to connect.

channels.name: Small Kevin's Redemption
channels.description: A sad, desperate blog by Kevin Smallwood (28) trying to rebuild his reputation after The Incident of March 2022 where he failed to catch Trust Fall Tim. Defensive, apologetic, pathetic.

channels.name: Big Mike from Tulsa
channels.description: The mysterious Michael Cornwell's aggressively normal personal blog. He's everywhere, it's just coincidence, and he'll explain why in excruciating detail. Every post raises more questions than it answers.

channels.name: QuantumBrewBlog
channels.description: Derek Observerson's obsessive fan blog about Quantum Coffee. Way too detailed, treating a joke coffee method as if it's a serious scientific endeavor. Peak 'guy who's way too into this' energy.
